name: Silence of the Gods
description: The event enacted by Kruphix that forced the deities to remain in Nyx without interfering with mortals.

description_citations.text: "Theros (plane)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Silence of the Gods enacted by Kruphix, Ephara withdraws her direct presence from the world.
timeline.quote: Ephara — like her fellow deities — withdrew her direct presence from the world.

citation.text: "Ephara", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Silence of the Gods leaves Erebos unable to receive souls, causing a buildup of eidolons and Returned.
timeline.quote: leaving him unable to receive souls into the Underworld

citation.text: "Erebos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kruphix imposes the Silence of the Gods as the pantheon goes to war.
timeline.quote: Kruphix saw fit to prevent the gods from interacting with the mortals

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Silence of the Gods leaves Iroas and the other deities unable to intervene in mortal affairs, creating challenges for his worshippers.
timeline.quote: Iroas was affected by the Silence of the Gods

citation.text: "Iroas", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 4559 AR Xenagos gathers monsters to attack Meletis, Akros and Setessa, causing the Silence of the Gods.
timeline.quote: These attacks became so severe that the gods themselves went blind

citation.text: "Meletis", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Silence of the Gods leaves Pharika unable to influence mortal diseases or healing.
timeline.quote: Pharika was affected by the Silence of the Gods

citation.text: "Pharika", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Silence of the Gods prevents Phenax from influencing mortal affairs.
timeline.quote: which prevented him from influencing mortal affairs during that period

citation.text: "Phenax", section "Silence of the Gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Purphoros is among the gods affected by the Silence of the Gods.
timeline.quote: Purphoros was among the gods affected by the Silence of the Gods

citation.text: "Purphoros", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Xenagos attacks the poleis with otherworldly monsters, blinding the gods, and Kruphix enacts the Silence of the Gods.
timeline.quote: Kruphix then enacted the Silence of the Gods

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kruphix enacted the Silence of the Gods, keeping the gods in Nyx.
timeline.quote: Kruphix then enacted the Silence of the Gods

citation.text: "Xenagos", section "Return to Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karametra is affected by the Silence of the Gods, when divine intervention ceased.
timeline.quote: Karametra was affected by the Silence of the Gods

citation.text: "Karametra", section "Silence of the Gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Before Xenagos's rise, Kruphix declared the Silence of the Gods to restore balance after chaos in Nyx.
timeline.quote: Kruphix declared the Silence of the Gods

citation.text: "Kruphix", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thassa is affected by the Silence of the Gods.
timeline.quote: was affected by the Silence of the Gods

citation.text: "Thassa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kruphix decrees the Silence of the Gods, withdrawing the pantheon into Nyx; Xenagos ascends to godhood as God of Revels.
timeline.quote: He decreed the Silence of the Gods
